messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for synth check "kv-read-eu": 6 failures within 1m in eu-west-1. PD: https://pagerduty.example/PD1234 severity=critical

pagerduty: Created INC-20260314-AB12 and page sent to oncall-sre. Auto-escalation in 9m.

Alex J: acked INC-20260314-AB12 :hand:

Samir K: I'll take it. quick scan — is this the read probe or write? label says kv-read-eu.

Alex J: it's the read probe. Runner logs show lots of 503s from prober-runner-3:
```
2026-03-14T09:11:52Z prober-runner-3 srv=kv-service-eu-1 op=synth-kv-get status=503 latency_ms=1120
2026-03-14T09:11:53Z prober-runner-3 srv=kv-service-eu-1 op=synth-kv-get status=503 latency_ms=998
```

Emily R: queue depth for prober-runner-3 spiked from 45 -> 980 in ~90s. backpressure visible.

Ops Lead: any customer-facing errors? support spikes?

Alex J: checked external error ingestion — no customer 5xx spike. This seems internal to the eu probe fanout hitting a backend.

Samir K: we rolled a config yesterday that increased prober fanout for blue tests. suspecting runaway concurrency. immediate mitigation: throttle prober concurrency and pause the heavy canary set.

Alex J: applying patch to synth-config to reduce concurrency to 25 for kv-read-eu.

Emily R: paste the kubectl patch so I can watch pods restart.

Alex J: running:
```
kubectl -n synth patch configmap synth-config --patch '{"data":{"kv-read-eu.concurrency":"25"}}'
```

incident-bot: ConfigMap synth-config updated at 2026-03-14T09:14:05Z. Prober pods restarted to pick up new concurrency.

pagerduty: INC-20260314-AB12 acknowledged by Alex J

Oncall SRE: seeing new pods with concurrency=25. queue_depth dropping to ~30 over 2m.

Samir K: replays show no 503s in latest 120 checks. backend 5xx rate normalizing.

Emily R: running a 3m smoke of the critical probe set: 180/180 passes.

Ops Lead: good catch. recommendation: suppress further PD pages for the synth-kv-read in eu for 30m while we monitor. Also open infra ticket to revert the config bump and add safety guardrails.

Alex J: created PD suppression: https://pagerduty.example/suppress/INC-20260314-AB12 (30m). Filed INF-8892 to rollback and add circuit breaker.

Emily R: note for postmortem: correlate with config deploy at 09:10 and prober pod restart timeline. I'll export graphs (queue_depth, probe latency, backend 5xx).

pagerduty: INC-20260314-AB12 marked resolved (suppression active). Will auto-close after 30m if no new alerts.

Alex J: will author short blameless postmortem and action items: 1) revert fanout bump, 2) add max concurrency cap and canary throttles, 3) integration test for prober behavior under heavy fanout.

Oncall SRE: handing off to next oncall in 10m. leaving notes in runbook and linking INF-8892 and PMEM-322.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging. Follow-ups: INF-8892, PMEM-322.
